items.title: Unit 2 · Story
items.prompt: Listen to the story. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenPrompt: Listen. Which word fills the gap?
items.storyText: This is my dad! He has a hat, a bag, and a map. That is my girl. She has a bat and a cap. At the house, we use the tap. Then we take a nap!
items.why: In “A Day with Dad”, you hear: This is my dad! The missing word is “dad”.
items.hint: Listen to this part again, or play the whole story.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 2, p.19 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
